headline: Ashish Kacholia adds ESDS Software and Ardee Industries in Q2
hook: New positions revealed in Kacholia Q2 filing
summary: Ace investor Ashish Kacholia adjusted his portfolio during the September quarter by adding new stakes in ESDS Software Solutions and Ardee Industries. He also disclosed a renewed holding in SG Finserve while increasing his investments in Indo SMC and Stove Kraft. headline: Ashish Kacholia adds three new stocks and increases two existing stakes
hook: Ace investor reshuffles Q2 portfolio holdings
summary: Ace investor Ashish Kacholia updated his portfolio in the second quarter of 2027. He increased his holdings in Indo SMC and Stove Kraft. Additionally, he initiated new positions in ESDS Software Solutions, Ardee Industries, and Credent Connect N Care. These moves reflect his current strategy in response to shifting market trends.
